title: Le mardi à distance
summary: A small workplace trial gives a team useful evidence about flexible schedules, but not a universal answer.

sentences.fr: Dans une équipe de douze personnes, la direction a permis le travail à distance le mardi pendant huit semaines.
sentences.en: In a twelve-person team, management allowed remote work on Tuesdays for eight weeks.

sentences.fr: Le bilan a montré que les déplacements avaient diminué, mais que les échanges spontanés étaient aussi moins fréquents.
sentences.en: The review showed that commutes had decreased, but spontaneous exchanges were also less frequent.

sentences.fr: Une collègue a conclu que le dispositif améliorait la concentration, tandis qu'un autre a dit manquer les discussions rapides.
sentences.en: One colleague concluded the arrangement improved concentration, while another said they missed quick discussions.

sentences.fr: La responsable a rappelé que les réponses venaient d'une seule équipe et ne représentaient pas tous les postes.
sentences.en: The manager noted that the responses came from one team and did not represent every role.
sentences.note: The passage separates observed changes from conclusions; a small trial does not by itself show what will work in every workplace.

sentences.fr: Le groupe a donc proposé de garder le mardi à distance tout en réservant une courte rencontre en personne le jeudi.
sentences.en: The group therefore proposed keeping Tuesday remote while reserving a short in-person meeting on Thursday.

sentences.fr: Cette formule pourrait convenir si les tâches nécessitant une coordination restent planifiées à l'avance.
sentences.en: This arrangement could work if tasks that require coordination are scheduled in advance.

sentences.fr: Après un autre mois, l'équipe comparera les mêmes indicateurs avant de recommander une règle plus générale.
sentences.en: After another month, the team will compare the same indicators before recommending a broader rule.

quiz.prompt: What changed during the eight-week trial?
options: Commuting decreased and spontaneous exchanges became less frequent
The team added a new office
quiz.explain: The review reported those two changes.

quiz.prompt: Why did the manager qualify the responses?
options: They came from one team, not every type of role
No one had answered the questions
The trial lasted a full year
quiz.explain: The manager explicitly limited what the responses could represent.

quiz.prompt: What will the team do before making a broader recommendation?
options: Compare the same indicators after another month
Assume the first result applies everywhere
quiz.explain: The final sentence describes the planned comparison.
